title: Architecture Decision (ISO 42010 §6 + SEBoK)
description: A recorded architecture decision. Art. IX: each relevant decision records at least one alternative and the criterion that rejected it.

alternatives.description: Art. IX — at least one alternative. An LLM usually goes to conventional solutions and does not tell that other solutions exist.

traces_to.description: The requirements, scenarios or concerns that cause the decision (FR-*, NFR-*, QS-*, CON-*, BD-*)

sensitivity_points.description: ATAM — the quality attributes that are sensitive to this decision

tradeoff_points.description: ATAM — the attributes that become worse when another attribute becomes better

tactics.description: Bass, Clements & Kazman — the applied tactics, as <attribute>/<tactic> (for example availability/active-redundancy)
